up: Find all molecules reported in document CHEMBL5244275. Return the following columns: molecule_chembl_id (from molecule_dictionary), pref_name (from molecule_dictionary), max_phase (from molecule_dictionary), molecule_type (from molecule_dictionary), and canonical_smiles (from compound_structures). Join the activities table to the docs table to filter by doc_id corresponding to CHEMBL5244275. Then join to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures using molregno or molecule_chembl_id equivalents. Ensure the query returns one row per unique molecule associated with that document.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5244275'
